name: dnb-content-viewer
title: DNB Book Content
description: Quick access to book contents from Deutsche Nationalbibliothek with AI-powered Klappentext generation
author: wdeu

commands.name: search-content
commands.title: Search Book Content
commands.description: Search for book contents in the Deutsche Nationalbibliothek using ISBN

preferences.name: contentType
preferences.title: Content to Open
preferences.description: Choose which content should be opened (when Klappentext disabled)

preferences.name: generateKlappentext
preferences.title: Klappentext generieren
preferences.label: AI-generierten Klappentext aus Inhaltsverzeichnis erstellen
preferences.description: Generiert automatisch einen Klappentext (max. 150 Wörter) + Suchwörter. Benötigt Raycast Pro oder BYOK.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
